two-hour-escape.name: Point Pleasant shore walk
two-hour-escape.description: Pick a shore-side path in Point Pleasant Park. Give the first half of your time to the outward walk and turn back while the harbour is still in view.
two-hour-escape.challenge: Listen for three distinct sounds between the trees and the shore.

two-hour-escape.name: A boardwalk photo hunt
two-hour-escape.description: Start at the central waterfront. Follow the boardwalk in one direction for 15 minutes, then look for a completely different photograph on your way back.
two-hour-escape.challenge: Frame a working boat, a reflection and one bit of old harbour hardware.

snack.name: COWS at Cable Wharf
snack.tip: Check seasonal hours for a waterfront ice cream.

two-hour-escape.name: Follow the canal at Shubie Park
two-hour-escape.description: Start near the Fairbanks Centre, follow the canal-side paths, then use the rest of your time to retrace your favourite stretch.
two-hour-escape.challenge: Find a trace of the old waterway and imagine how a boat would get past it.

snack.name: Two If By Sea Café
snack.tip: Add time for a separate pastry stop in downtown Dartmouth.

two-hour-escape.name: Watch the Fraser at Derby Reach
two-hour-escape.description: Make a riverside out-and-back from Edgewater Bar. Leave ten minutes at the end to sit and watch the working river.
two-hour-escape.challenge: Look for something travelling upstream and something travelling down.

snack.name: Blacksmith Bakery
snack.tip: Add time for a pastry stop in Fort Langley village.

two-hour-escape.name: A slow wander in Campbell Valley
two-hour-escape.description: Use the official park map to choose a section near the Little River Loop. Pause at a wetland viewpoint before retracing your route.
two-hour-escape.challenge: Spot three changes in the landscape without leaving the trail.

two-hour-escape.name: A pocket garden and a creek
two-hour-escape.description: Take a short loop among the plantings at Sendall Gardens, then slow down beside Muckle Creek.
two-hour-escape.challenge: Find one interesting leaf shape and one reflection.

rainy-saturday.name: A five-floor book hunt
rainy-saturday.description: Pick a subject neither of you knows, find the most surprising book on it, and trade one fact before you leave.
rainy-saturday.challenge: Finish with a look out over Spring Garden Road.

rainy-saturday.name: A day among ship models
rainy-saturday.description: Choose one vessel in the museum. Look for a detail that tells you how people lived or worked aboard.
rainy-saturday.challenge: Pick the object you would put on a Halifax postcard.

rainy-saturday.name: A gallery colour hunt
rainy-saturday.description: Choose one colour at the door and follow it through the galleries. Compare the two most different ways artists used it.
rainy-saturday.challenge: Give your favourite work a second title of your own.

rainy-saturday.name: A village library detour
rainy-saturday.description: Pick a Canadian author from the shelves. Read the first page of two books, then choose which story you want to take home.
rainy-saturday.challenge: Find a cover that could pass for a postcard from BC.

rainy-saturday.name: A hangar sketchbook visit
rainy-saturday.description: Spend the indoor part of your visit comparing aircraft shapes. Sketch two wing outlines and see if your companion can identify them.
rainy-saturday.challenge: Choose a cockpit you would like to see from the pilot’s seat.

rainy-saturday.name: Plan a miniature local expedition
rainy-saturday.description: Find a travel book about a place you could reach in a day. Each person picks one stop and explains what makes it worth the journey.
rainy-saturday.challenge: Sketch the route on a scrap of paper before you check a map.
